newsitem.title: FINLAND: TULIKIVI RISES SHARPLY ON 4-MTH RESULT.
newsitem.headline: TULIKIVI RISES SHARPLY ON 4-MTH RESULT.

text.p: Shares in Finnish stone oven maker Tulikivi rose sharply on Tuesday after the group reported January-April profits up strongly, brokers said.

At 1455/1145 GMT, Tulikivi traded at 92.00 markka, up 5.00 markka or almost six percent, after setting a new year-high of 95.00 markka earlier in the session. The one million markka volume was fair in the usually little-traded share.

Tulikivi reported four-month profits up to 8.4 million markka from 0.4 million a year ago, and said it expected full-year 1997 earnings to be better than last year when it had profits before extras and tax of 14.9 million markka.

"It was a good result," one broker said of Tulikivi's four-month performance, but he predicted that investors would soon forget about the small cap and that volumes would return to their usual low levels.
